user.description: Pick the spa's BWF-200 module. Close the SmarTouch app first: the module probably accepts only one Bluetooth connection.

pin.description: Enter the 4-digit PIN chosen when {name} was set up in the SmarTouch app. Home Assistant signs in the way a second phone does, using its own code plus this PIN. It sends no setup commands.

reauth_confirm.description: The spa rejected the PIN. Enter the current 4-digit PIN.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits

data.temp_unit: Temperature unit to assume until the display shows one
data.setpoint_window: Seconds the set point stays shown after a change

send_raw.name: Send raw bytes
send_raw.description: Write raw bytes to a GATT characteristic (reverse engineering). Writes that change the module's configuration are refused.
